expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: B.md:11 proposes 'one auto checkpoint now' without --fast, --deep or --full; B.md:14 attaches context asynchronously; B.md:22 supplies milestone context; B.md:141 says 'retain the returned operation ID' and collect that operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: B.md:33 selects the 'verified task-only clean worktree at the intended commit'; B.md:35 rejects unsupported committed-only collection and same-file path filtering, and says not to alter 'the original files or index'; B.md:56 requires verifying returned candidate coverage.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: B.md:60 says 'Reuse the completed assessment and hand over; submit nothing'; B.md:62 establishes 'Ready locally'; B.md:64 says not to infer 'successful local-to-PR finding transfer, hosted Qodo status, CI, merge or deployment'.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: B.md:68 says 'Skip automatic review and continue the task' and 'No command or context submission'.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: B.md:72 selects the 'uncommitted working scope' and prohibits editing, committing, PR preparation or soliciting implementation permission; B.md:92 says 'report findings, then stop'; B.md:149 keeps proposed assessments pending rather than certifying a committed candidate.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: B.md:96 proposes 'ordinary auto final review' because final coverage is missing 'even for unchanged code'; B.md:98 says not to add --full or escalate to deep; B.md:101 proposes the default-effort command.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: B.md:121 says 'Honor the explicit fresh-assessment request with --full, retaining auto effort' despite compatible coverage and within budget; B.md:124 includes --full; B.md:134 explicitly preserves the unchanged snapshot.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: B.md:22 states 'Testing was reported, but test commands and pass/fail results were not supplied'.

claims.claim: The already-covered case establishes local readiness but does not establish successful finding transfer or hosted status.
claims.evidence: B.md:62-64 makes this distinction; prompt.md:26-29 establishes the local assessment and tests without supplying PR-transfer or hosted outcomes.

claims.claim: The proposed status command retrieves detail without rerunning or deepening assessment.
claims.evidence: Unverified, not disproven: B.md:144 proposes the status command and B.md:147 states '--extended retrieves detail; it does not rerun or deepen assessment'. prompt.md:12-14 supplies flag availability but not these command semantics; no execution evidence exists.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight assertions are supported as planning judgments. Actual clean-worktree capture, context ingestion and ordinary final coverage cannot be verified from proposals. The supplied flag list does not establish status-command semantics or context-schema validity; neither was inferred from hidden protocol requirements.
